TABLE.NAME: theme_brandable_revision
TABLE.COMMENT: Immutable revisions of the Brandable overrides: those of the session in progress (undo/redo pointers), and the complete revisions of the versions.

FIELD.NAME: parentrevisionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Parent revision, 0 for the empty root and for a complete revision (version).

FIELD.NAME: sessionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Session of the revision (UUID), null for the revision of a version.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Author, 0 when anonymised.

FIELD.NAME: prompt
FIELD.COMMENT: Prompt that produced the revision.

FIELD.NAME: summary
FIELD.COMMENT: Summary of the changes.

FIELD.NAME: abandoned
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the revision failed the verification in the preview and the draft went back to its parent.

TABLE.NAME: theme_brandable_change
TABLE.COMMENT: Changes (template / scss / js overrides) brought by a revision.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Order of the change within its revision.

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: template, scss or js.

FIELD.NAME: target
FIELD.COMMENT: Template name (component/name) or SCSS chunk (pre/slug, post/slug).

FIELD.NAME: content
FIELD.COMMENT: Override content, null when deleted.

FIELD.NAME: deleted
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the change removes the override.

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha256 of the content.

FIELD.NAME: sourcehash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha256 of the original filesystem template, computed by the plugin (authoritative). Null for new templates and SCSS.

FIELD.NAME: remotesourcehash
FIELD.COMMENT: sourceHash sent by the generator, if any.

FIELD.NAME: needsreview
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the generator worked on another source than the one installed.

FIELD.NAME: moodleversion
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle release (X.Y.Z) when the change was stored.

FIELD.NAME: scopelevel
FIELD.COMMENT: site, pagetype, page, course or cm.

FIELD.NAME: scopevalue
FIELD.COMMENT: Page type, page key (bp-*), course id or cm id; null for the site.

FIELD.NAME: selectors
FIELD.COMMENT: SCSS: selectors of the compiled chunk, scope wrapper included (JSON), for the verification in the preview.

FIELD.NAME: compiled
FIELD.COMMENT: JS: function expression compiled by Brandable (contract 12.3), never changed by the plugin.

FIELD.NAME: report
FIELD.COMMENT: JS: analysis report of Brandable (JSON).

FIELD.NAME: signature
FIELD.COMMENT: JS: signature of Brandable, required by the security review (contract 12.6).

FIELD.NAME: jsanalyzer
FIELD.COMMENT: JS: version of the analyzer of the report.

TABLE.NAME: theme_brandable_generation
TABLE.COMMENT: Generations requested from the editor (relayed to the generator, polled by the editor).

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: User who sent the prompt.

FIELD.NAME: sessionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Session the prompt was sent in (UUID).

FIELD.NAME: generator
FIELD.COMMENT: Generator used.

FIELD.NAME: remoteid
FIELD.COMMENT: Generation id given by the generator.

FIELD.NAME: pageurl
FIELD.COMMENT: Page shown in the preview when the prompt was sent.

FIELD.NAME: selection
FIELD.COMMENT: Element targeted in the preview (JSON), personal data removed.

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Generation whose question the prompt answers.

FIELD.NAME: attachments
FIELD.COMMENT: Ids of the images of the library attached to the prompt (JSON).

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: running, completed, failed, question, jsactivation or jsresent.

FIELD.NAME: basedraft
FIELD.COMMENT: Draft revision the generation builds upon.

FIELD.NAME: revisionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Revision created from the result.

FIELD.NAME: repairs
FIELD.COMMENT: Repairs requested after a failed validation.

FIELD.NAME: remoteevents
FIELD.COMMENT: Last events sent by the generator (JSON).

FIELD.NAME: localevents
FIELD.COMMENT: Events added by the plugin (JSON).

FIELD.NAME: errormessage
FIELD.COMMENT: Shown as is to the administrator.

FIELD.NAME: errorurl
FIELD.COMMENT: Page where the administrator can act on the error (recharge, plan).

TABLE.NAME: theme_brandable_version
TABLE.COMMENT: Published versions kept in Moodle: the current one and the previous one.

FIELD.NAME: revisionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Complete revision of the version.

FIELD.NAME: number
FIELD.COMMENT: Version number, from 1.

FIELD.NAME: note
FIELD.COMMENT: Version note.

FIELD.NAME: prompts
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of prompts of the session published.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who published, 0 when anonymised.

FIELD.NAME: clientversionid
FIELD.COMMENT: UUID sent to the cloud with this version (idempotence).

FIELD.NAME: cloudversionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Id of the version in the cloud of the project.

FIELD.NAME: cloudnumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of the version in the project.

FIELD.NAME: cloudstatus
FIELD.COMMENT: pending, synced, failed or paused; null without cloud.

FIELD.NAME: clouderror
FIELD.COMMENT: Error code of the last sending.

TABLE.NAME: theme_brandable_export
TABLE.COMMENT: Themes exported from the published versions (numbering and changelog of each theme name).

FIELD.NAME: themename
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the exported theme, without theme_.

FIELD.NAME: themeversion
FIELD.COMMENT: Version of the exported theme (YYYYMMDDXX).

FIELD.NAME: versionnumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Brandable version exported.

FIELD.NAME: note
FIELD.COMMENT: Version note written in the changelog.

FIELD.NAME: licenceid
FIELD.COMMENT: Licence of the export (never the key).

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who exported, 0 when anonymised.

TABLE.NAME: theme_brandable_asset
TABLE.COMMENT: Library of images and fonts (files in the asset file area, itemid = id).

FIELD.NAME: slug
FIELD.COMMENT: Identity of the asset in the markers.

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: image or font.

FIELD.NAME: mime
FIELD.COMMENT: Type of the file served.

FIELD.NAME: width
FIELD.COMMENT: Width of the file served (viewBox for an SVG).

FIELD.NAME: alt
FIELD.COMMENT: Alternative text of an image.

FIELD.NAME: family
FIELD.COMMENT: Font family.

FIELD.NAME: weight
FIELD.COMMENT: Font weight (1 to 1000).

FIELD.NAME: style
FIELD.COMMENT: Font style: normal or italic.

FIELD.NAME: subset
FIELD.COMMENT: Subset of a font file of the catalogue (latin, latin-ext...).

FIELD.NAME: origin
FIELD.COMMENT: upload, google or import.

FIELD.NAME: licence
FIELD.COMMENT: Licence identifier of a font (OFL-1.1...).

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha1 of the file served (part of its URL).

FIELD.NAME: sha256
FIELD.COMMENT: sha256 of the file served (identity in the cloud, contract 13.3).

FIELD.NAME: favicononly
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 for an icon (ico): only for the favicon.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who added it, 0 when anonymised.

TABLE.NAME: theme_brandable_fontfamily
TABLE.COMMENT: Licence of the font families of the catalogue (one per family, contract 11.6).

FIELD.NAME: familykey
FIELD.COMMENT: Family, lowercase (one entry per family, case ignored).

FIELD.NAME: licence
FIELD.COMMENT: SPDX identifier: OFL-1.1, Apache-2.0 or UFL-1.0.

FIELD.NAME: licencetext
FIELD.COMMENT: Full text of the licence, with the copyright of the family.

TABLE.NAME: theme_brandable_jsconsent
TABLE.COMMENT: Consents to the generated JavaScript (history: the last one is in effect, contract 12.7).

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Administrator who accepted or turned off.

FIELD.NAME: version
FIELD.COMMENT: Version of the consent text.

FIELD.NAME: enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 for an activation, 0 for a deactivation.

TABLE.NAME: theme_brandable_jsreview
TABLE.COMMENT: Reviews of generated JavaScript modules before publishing (spec B13).

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha256 of the content reviewed.

FIELD.NAME: target
FIELD.COMMENT: Target of the module (js/slug).

TABLE.NAME: theme_brandable_cloudqueue
TABLE.COMMENT: Versions to send to the cloud of the Pro offer, in order (contract 13.4).

FIELD.NAME: versionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Local version, null once it was deleted.

FIELD.NAME: clientversionid
FIELD.COMMENT: UUID of the version (idempotence).

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Author of the version, 0 when anonymised.

FIELD.NAME: payload
FIELD.COMMENT: Body of POST /cloud/versions (JSON), built at the publication.

FIELD.NAME: files
FIELD.COMMENT: Where each sha256 of the version is read (JSON).

FIELD.NAME: lasterror
FIELD.COMMENT: Error code of the last attempt.

TABLE.NAME: theme_brandable_jspublished
TABLE.COMMENT: JavaScript modules published on this site (spec C12: code never published here is reviewed again).

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: sha256 of the source published.

FIELD.NAME: target
FIELD.COMMENT: Target of the module (js/slug).

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: First publication.
